_comment: The agent-system registry. One entry per upstream system that actually executes agents.
This is a REGISTRY, NOT AN ENUM. A system named in source outside its own adapter is a
mistake - the same rule that applies to agent names. Adding an agentic AEM or an agentic
Campaign later is a new entry here, not a schema change.
Shape:  practice (domain) -> agent_system (upstream) -> agents (discovered at runtime)
Agent names, labels and owners are NEVER written here. They come from the upstream's own
catalog via agents_path, so Chauncey stays the single source of truth for what his agents
are called. Add a fifth agent there and it appears here with no change on our side.
Editable from Settings and from Claude (set_agent_system), so this file is a seed, not a

systems.label: Xfinity Creative Intake
notes: Chauncey Plummer's harness (chaunceyplum/intake_harness), with its MCP estate at mcp_endpoint.
Four agents: intake, review, audience_creation, escalation. Escalation is invoked only when a run fails.
Capture is POLLED, not intercepted: the orchestrator calls its agents server-side, so we read the run back afterwards.
This host currently has no authentication on any route.
VERIFIED 16 Sep 2026 against the live endpoint - 238 tools on /mcp:
* The knowledge tool is `search_adobe_knowledge`. `search_knowledge_base` DOES NOT EXIST.
That single wrong name is why every intake step fails while still reporting completed.
* Agent 3's AEP tools are all present: adobe_create_segment_estimate, adobe_get_segment_estimate,
* The Workfront routes are NOT deployed at this gateway: /mcp/workfront/core, /comments,
/search and /metadata all return HTTP 404 'Not Found'. template.yaml in chaunceyplum/mcp
declares all eight of them, so the deployed stack is behind the repo, or they live behind
a different API. Nothing can call wf_* here until that is resolved.
* POST /api/runs requires { "input": { "brief": ... } } - the payload is nested, not top level.
